To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the teaching and assessment of multicultural competence in a distance education program is possible; (b) the use of this approach is associated with increased student knowledge of cultural issues in assessment and a positive attitude towards the assessment of ethnic minority clients; and (c) the use of a modular approach to teaching multicultural assessment competencies is a viable approach that is associated with a positive student response and preliminary evidence of increased student performance on the assessment of ethnic minorities.
